properties.name: P1_SingleCover
properties.meaning: exactly one cover/title slide and it is slide 1

properties.name: P2_SingleClosing
properties.meaning: exactly one closing slide and it is the last slide n

properties.name: P3_ExactDeck
properties.meaning: the concatenated deck is exactly global slides 1..n in order: no loss, duplication, reordering or extra slides

properties.name: C2_PlanPartition
properties.statement: plan[1].start = 1 /\ plan[NB].end = n /\ contiguous /\ NB = BatchCountFormula(n)
properties.meaning: the plan partitions 1..n contiguously and its length equals the API's batchCount

properties.name: L1_EventuallyMerged
properties.meaning: every behaviour eventually yields the merged deck (WF on Next)

properties.name: Sanity_NeverMergedThreeBatches
properties.meaning: sanity check that MUST fail: a merged 3-batch deck is reachable

findings.story: n=3, BatchSize=2 → batches [1-2],[3]. Batch 1 renders slides 1,2. Batch 2's prompt does not restrict it to global slide 3 (ScopeContract off, as in the pre-fix target_data "Source Script Slides s to e"), so it re-renders slide 2. The user concatenates: <<1,2,2>> — slide 3 lost, slide 2 duplicated. With the legacy prompt (all toggles off) even a single batch may render fewer slides than n (length: "dynamic"). On the real pre-fix code (85f2104) the checker reproduces the historic symptom: n=80 → 81 slides = extra title + 4 x slides 1..20, covers at positions 1,2,22,42,62, no closing.
